key_claims.claim: Externally validated ultrasound prognostic markers can stratify pump-twin survival risk in TRAP sequence, supporting more evidence-based intervention timing
Growth-restricted fetuses show bilateral MPI elevation and diastolic dysfunction, with early-onset FGR demonstrating more pronounced cardiac changes
Only about one-quarter of patients with positive cfDNA for sex chromosome aneuploidies pursue confirmatory testing, with uptake disparities linked to insurance, ethnicity, and deprivation
Ophthalmic artery PSV ratio correlates with sFlt-1/PlGF ratios in late preterm pregnancies, offering a non-invasive surrogate for angiogenic imbalance
Monozygotic twins have elevated risk of concordant structural malformations in specific anatomical clusters independent of chorionicity-related hemodynamic effects
